2608.28490.title: LLM-Based Agents for Software and Systems Security: Approaches, Applications, and Assessment
2608.28490.paper_summary: Software and systems security workflows are typically procedural: analysts inspect heterogeneous artifacts, form hypotheses, invoke tools, interpret outputs, and revise plans. Large language model (LLM)-based agents, which can plan, use tools, retain state, and revise actions across multi-step workflows, are being rapidly adopted to automate this work. Given the consequences of delegating security decisions to autonomous systems, understanding how such agents are built, used, and assessed is crucial. Yet to this date, there remains a lack of systematic understanding of what has been done and how far we are in this field: the term "agent" is applied inconsistently, applications differ sharply in risk, and assessment protocols are often incomparable. To gain a comprehensive and coherent view of this area hence inform relevant future research, this paper provides a systematic literature review of the (1) technical approaches, including agent architecture, perception, memory, reasoning and planning, action space, orchestration, and self-improvement, (2) applications, with respect to the security tasks served, and (3) assessment, including the datasets, outcome and trajectory metrics, safety measures, and baselines considered, over the peer-reviewed literature spanning the emergence of this area (2023--2026). Our synthesis reveals a field that has built agents able to act but not yet agents whose authority is bounded or whose behavior is auditable. In addition to knowledge systematization, we also extend our insights into the limitations of and challenges faced by current approach, application, and assessment designs, which shed light on potentially promising future research directions.
2608.28490.paper_summary_zh: 軟體和系統安全工作流程通常是程序性的：分析師檢查異質的工件，形成假設，調用工具，解釋輸出，並修訂計劃。基於大型語言模型（LLM）的代理正在迅速被採用來自動化這項工作，這些代理能夠計劃、使用工具、保持狀態並在多步工作流程中修訂行動。考慮到將安全決策委託給自主系統的後果，了解這些代理是如何構建、使用和評估的至關重要。然而，到目前為止，對於這一領域已經做了什麼以及我們的進展程度仍然缺乏系統性的理解：“代理”這個術語的應用不一致，應用在風險上差異明顯，評估協議往往無法比較。為了獲得這一領域的全面和一致的視角，從而為相關的未來研究提供信息，本文提供了一個系統的文獻綜述，包括（1）技術方法，涵蓋代理架構、感知、記憶、推理和規劃、行動空間、協調和自我改進，（2）應用，與所服務的安全任務相關，以及（3）評估，包括考慮的數據集、結果和軌跡指標、安全措施和基準，涵蓋了從這一領域出現以來的同行評審文獻（2023--2026）。我們的綜合分析顯示，這是一個已經構建出能夠行動的代理的領域，但尚未構建出其權限受到限制或行為可審計的代理。除了知識的系統化，我們還擴展了對當前方法、應用和評估設計所面臨的限制和挑戰的見解，這為潛在的有前景的未來研究方向提供了啟示。
